units.source_text: 妻子跑了之后，匪徒抢走了我的大刀和弓箭，割断了我的绳子。

en.t: After my wife ran away, the bandit took my long sword and bow and arrows, and cut my ropes.

units.source_text: 我真切的记得匪徒消失在竹林外之前，自言自语说：“这回要看你的自己了。”

en.t: I remember clearly that before the bandit vanished beyond the bamboo grove, he said to himself, "This time, it is up to you."
After that, everything fell utterly silent.

units.source_text: 不是，隐隐约约还有哭声。

en.t: No, not quite; faintly, there was still the sound of crying.

units.source_text: 我细心聆听，啊，这不就是我自己的哭声吗？

en.t: I listened closely, and ah, was that not the sound of my own crying?
